summary: Frontend-only validation of the new Pricing section, ongoing-project price labels (cards, home 'Building Next' rows, project detail chip), and Landowner Development Partnership section + enquiry dialog on My Dream Projects site. All 7 requested feature checks pass. No console errors on Home or /projects.
critical_code_review_comments: Landowner form's email field has no format validation beyond browser-native — acceptable for WhatsApp handoff.

The mobile viewport re-set inside a single Playwright session after navigation appeared not to shrink the layout in the harness (scrollW=1920 despite setting 390 width). This is likely a harness quirk (viewport re-application after page.goto); visual/manual mobile testing recommended. No horizontal overflow was detected regardless.
Home.jsx is now ~820 lines with many inline components (Hero, Stats, Pricing, Landowner, etc.). Consider extracting sections into /components/home/* for maintainability (soft nudge, not blocking).
